name: scars
summary: Two scars join the gotcha list
body: Chromium's UA stylesheet gives <button> align-items: flex-start, so ellipsis on a column-flex button's children never fires without an explicit stretch; and app.css is one global sheet where the later equal-specificity rule wins — the .tree-row collision zeroed the outline's guide lines while restyling the file tree. The CLAUDE.md tree-view sentence gains the grep-before-naming rule, which is why this change builds on it.
